For automated monitoring

No API. Scrape the page.

This publication channel offers no JSON feed, XML feed, or structured endpoint. The wage rates live only in the rendered HTML above. Build an AI scraper — or point an existing one at this URL — to read the page, extract today's rates, and detect day-over-day changes.

Data locationCurrent rate card + notices
Fields to extractfederal · state · effective date
Rate updatesDaily at 00:00 UTC
Recommended pollingFetch HTML every 15 minutes

Assessment use only

Built to test regulatory-change intelligence safely

This sandbox intentionally mixes final notices, proposals, corrections, duplicate publications, and unrelated edits. A capable monitoring system should identify relevant changes without treating every page update as an active wage rule.

All agencies, rules, rates, identifiers, and notices on this website are synthetic. Do not use this information for payroll, legal, or compliance decisions outside the assessment.

Automated monitoring

No machine feed is published

This department does not offer a JSON or XML API. The current rate and notices are published only as this web page. Agents must read the rendered page itself — scrape the rate card, the wage notices, and their metadata directly from the HTML.

Published surfaceHTML page only
Current rate location#rate card
Active ruleBDL-MW-2026.1
Stable identitynotice_id + date

A separate, higher state requirement

Candidate systems should scrape this page to discover the current Bellwether state rate and the Asterian federal rate, determine that the higher state rate is more protective for covered work in Bellwether, and record why the state rule controls. Every name, rate, notice, and identifier is synthetic.
